name: jetapi-mcp-server
description: Send WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS and MAX messages, files and bulk mailings via JetAPI
long_description: Official JetAPI extension. Lets Claude send text messages and files through WhatsApp, a personal Telegram account, Telegram bots, SMS, VK/OK and MAX — with channel cascades, scheduling and bulk mailings — check delivery status, look up phone numbers and manage webhooks. Requires a JetAPI token from https://jetapi.io.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Full account info: balance, dispatch routing, sender names, subscription and messenger sessions

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Balance, customer ID, dispatch routing channels and sender names

tools.name: get_utm_tags
tools.description: List UTM tags used to track dispatches

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text via WhatsApp, Telegram, Telegram Bot, SMS, VK/OK or MAX with cascade and scheduling

tools.name: send_bulk
tools.description: Send the same message to many phone numbers at once

tools.name: get_delivery_status
tools.description: Status and details of a delivery

tools.name: delete_delivery
tools.description: Delete a delivered WhatsApp/Telegram message on all devices

tools.name: get_phone_info
tools.description: Country, operator and normalized format of a phone number

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Send a document, image, audio or video file

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Subscribe a URL to incoming messages, statuses and login events

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Change a webhook's URL or event types

jetapi_token.title: JetAPI token
jetapi_token.description: Bearer token from your JetAPI dashboard (https://jetapi.io)

jetapi_base_url.title: API base URL
jetapi_base_url.description: Leave the default unless you use a white-label JetAPI installation
